name: Uruguaysuchus
sum: Uruguaysuchus is a small to moderate-sized crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous Guichón Formation of Uruguay.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Rusconi in 1933.
material: Remains of two species (U. aznarezi and U. terrai) from the Guichón Formation.
biology: Related to Simosuchus and Malawisuchus; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Rusconi 1933
